KSHV protein kinase modulates KAP-1 activity, which affects the ability of this cellular transcriptional repressors to condense chromosomal structure at the promoters of viral lytic genes.

the viral protein kinase modulated the chromatin remodeling of the cellular transcriptional regulator KAP-1, thereby affecting the viral gene expression and the viral life cycle.

KSHV protein kinase modulates KAP-1 function, which is critical for the viral lytic program.
